traits.name: Aura of the Unremembered
traits.description: The King radiates drifting grey ash in a 20ft radius. The area is lightly obscured, creatures other than the King have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks inside it. Any creature that enters the aura for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage.

traits.name: Impossible Anatomy
traits.description: The King can move through the space of other creatures. First time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature must make DC 18 Dexterity save or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The King cannot end its turn inside another creature.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.description: If the King fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Phase II - The Eye Opens
traits.description: When the King is reduced to 100 HP, every creature within 30ft must make DC 17 Wisdom save: 18 (4d8) psychic damage and frightened until end of next turn on failure, half damage on success. Then the King gains: Second Movement - can teleport up to 30ft as bonus action; Eye of the Void - Void Lance deals 22 (4d10) psychic; Nightmare Pulse - at start of each of its turns, one random creature within 60ft takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The King makes two Ruin Claw attacks and one Void Lance attack.

actions.name: Ruin Claw
actions.description: Melee weapon attack: +11 to hit, reach 10ft, one target. Hit: 15 (2d8+6) slashing plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Void Lance
actions.description: Ranged spell attack: +9 to hit, range 90ft, one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage and target must succeed on DC 17 Wisdom save or cannot take reactions until start of its next turn. After Phase II: 22 (4d10) psychic.

actions.name: Collapse Reality
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6) Choose point within 90ft. Each creature in 20ft-radius sphere must make DC 18 Dexterity save: 27 (6d8) force damage and knocked prone on failure, half damage and not prone on success. Area becomes unstable until end of encounter: movement costs double, teleportation into/out of it fails, creatures standing there have disadvantage on Dexterity saves.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: The King moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Ruin Claw
legendary_actions.description: Costs 2 Actions. The King makes one Ruin Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Tear Open
legendary_actions.description: Costs 2 Actions. The King makes one Void Lance attack.

monsterData.description: Enormous humanoid turned living ruin of black stone and corpse-grey flesh. Broken pillars from back, long black tendrils, featureless face except single cyan eye with concentric markings. Telepathic: 'You remember me.'

traits.name: Unblinking Presence
traits.description: When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the Witness and can see it, it must make a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it becomes Unnerved until the start of its next turn: speed reduced by 10ft, cannot willingly move closer to the Witness, disadvantage on first attack roll that turn. On success, immune to this Witness's Unblinking Presence for 24 hours.

traits.name: Reality Distortion
traits.description: At the start of each of the Witness's turns, choose one effect in a 15ft radius around it (no action required). Effect lasts until the start of its next turn: Gravity - creatures of Witness's choice must DC 15 Strength save or be pushed 10ft. Silence - no sound can be produced in area, verbal components fail. Warp - area becomes difficult terrain.

actions.name: Void Tendril
actions.description: Ranged spell attack: +7 to hit, range 60ft, one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) psychic damage and target must succeed on DC 15 Strength save or be pulled 10 feet toward the Witness.

actions.name: Stone-Fused Fist
actions.description: Melee weapon attack: +5 to hit, reach 10ft, one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Memory Fracture
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6) One creature within 60ft must make DC 16 Wisdom save. Failure: 27 (6d8) psychic damage and incapacitated until end of its next turn. Success: half damage. The target briefly sees a personal memory - no words are spoken by the Witness.

monsterData.description: Tall humanoid fused into black stone covered in concentric circular markings. No mouth, smooth face, single cyan eye in center of chest. Does not chase - it watches.

traits.name: Void-Hunter
traits.description: The Stalker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while in dim light, fog, ruins, or heavily obscured terrain. It can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Impossible Step
traits.description: As a bonus action, the Stalker teleports up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Black smoke fills the space it left until the start of its next turn, making that space lightly obscured.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Stalker makes two Rending Claw attacks.

actions.name: Rending Claw
actions.description: Melee weapon attack: +7 to hit, reach 5ft, one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. If both claw attacks hit the same creature on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet toward the Stalker.

actions.name: Shriek of the Hollow
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6) The Stalker releases a soundless psychic scream. Each creature within 20 feet must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure: 13 (3d8) psychic damage, frightened until the end of its next turn, and cannot take reactions. On a success: half damage and no other effect.

monsterData.description: Gaunt quadruped of blackened bone and ash-grey flesh with no head - small cyan eyes open along its shoulders and ribcage. Hunts through ruins and climbs walls.

wounds.description: The creature can’t take reactions until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Antimagic Cone
traits.description: Central eye creates 150-ft. cone of antimagic. Suppresses spells and magic items in area. Beholder decides direction each round.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.description: If beholder fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. 3/day.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description: Shoots three of ten eye rays at random targets within 120 ft. Each ray: DC 16 DEX save. Rays: 1-Charm (WIS save, charmed 1 hr), 2-Paralyze (CON save, paralyzed 1 min), 3-Fear (WIS save, frightened 1 min), 4-Slow (WIS save, slowed 1 min), 5-Enervation (55/10d10 necrotic, CON half), 6-Telekinetic (moved 30 ft, CON save), 7-Sleep (fall unconscious 1 min, CON save each round), 8-Petrification (CON save each round, 3 fails = petrified), 9-Disintegration (45/10d8 force, DEX half, destroys objects), 10-Death (55/10d10 necrotic, CON half; 0 HP = dies instantly).
